districtFact: Adams 12 Five Star Schools uses a quarter-based calendar with a separate orientation day for sixth- and ninth-grade students before classes begin for all students. The PDF notes that sixth-grade orientation does not apply to K–8 schools and that high schools may choose different staff workdays in April and May.

about.title: About the Adams 12 Calendar
about.content: The Adams 12 school calendar is organized into four quarters, with major weeklong breaks and staff workdays near holidays and quarter boundaries. Those staff workdays create additional no-school days for students.

about.title: Grade and School-Type Exceptions
about.content: Sixth- and ninth-grade students attend orientation before classes begin for all students. The district notes that sixth-grade orientation does not apply to K–8 schools. For two spring staff workdays, each high school may choose another date in April or May.

planningTips.title: Adams 12 Calendar Notes
content: Families of sixth graders at K–8 schools should confirm whether the district orientation date applies.
Families of high school students should confirm the April and May staff workdays selected by their school.
Staff workdays may follow Labor Day, Presidents Day, and winter break, extending the time students are out of school.
Each official PDF is marked subject to revision, so verify the district page before booking travel or arranging care.

districtFaqs.q: Do sixth- and ninth-grade students start early in Adams 12?
districtFaqs.a: They attend orientation one day before classes begin for all students. The district notes that sixth-grade orientation does not apply to K–8 schools.

districtFaqs.q: Are all Adams 12 staff workdays fixed districtwide?
districtFaqs.a: Most listed staff workdays are district dates, but the April and May entries state that high schools may choose a different day in the same month.
Yes. The official calendars identify the end of quarters 1 through 4, with the fourth quarter ending on the last student day.

districtFaqs.q: Where should families verify calendar changes?
districtFaqs.a: Use the official Adams 12 calendar page and the current school-year PDF. Families should also check individual high school and K–8 calendars for the exceptions noted by the district.
